stories.brief: Dozens of private schools in East Jerusalem did not open for the new school year because their teachers and staff from the West Bank had not received renewed work permits. The useful vocabulary is daily and concrete: schools, teachers, permits, reopening, and families trying to start the year normally despite a paperwork and access dispute.

A democratic school in Pardes Hanna was broken into and daubed with swastikas and a racial slur, prompting municipal condemnation and a police investigation. The story is usable for everyday language about schools, vandalism, hate symbols, and how a community reacts when a local institution is targeted.

stories.brief: A new study found that Israel lost more than 500 doctors in two years, with the average annual outflow far above pre-pandemic levels and surgeons especially prominent among those leaving. The story is concrete and workplace-focused: doctors, hospitals, staffing pressure, and the strain this puts on everyday care.

sources.title: הבריחה מחריפה: ישראל איבדה מעל 500 רופאים בשנתיים - פי 5 מהקצב הרגיל

teaser.text: מחקר חדש מראה שיותר מ־500 רופאים עזבו את ישראל בשנתיים.

translations.ru: Новое исследование показывает, что более 500 врачей уехали из Израиля за два года.
translations.en: A new study shows that more than 500 doctors left Israel in two years.

teaser.text: מחקר חדש מצא שיותר מ־500 רופאים עזבו את ישראל בתוך שנתיים, והרבה מהם היו מנתחים.

translations.ru: Новое исследование показало, что более 500 врачей уехали из Израиля за два года, и многие из них были хирургами.
translations.en: A new study found that more than 500 doctors left Israel in two years, and many of them were surgeons.

translations.ru: Новое исследование показало, что отъезд врачей из Израиля вырос гораздо выше темпа, который был до короны, и особенно выделялись хирурги.
translations.en: A new study found that doctors’ departure from Israel rose far above the pace before the pandemic, and surgeons stood out in particular.

stories.brief: Israel’s July 2026 consumer price index rose 0.3 percent, while annual inflation eased to 1.5 percent and housing prices were nearly flat month to month. The most practical vocabulary is everyday consumer language: transportation, food, clothing, fuel, and what price changes mean for households.

sources.title: מדד יולי עלה ב-0.3%, האינפלציה השנתית - 1.5%; יציבות במחירי הדירות

teaser.text: מדד יולי עלה ב־0.3%, והמחירים של הדירות כמעט לא השתנו.

translations.ru: Июльский индекс вырос на 0,3%, а цены на квартиры почти не изменились.
translations.en: The July index rose by 0.3%, and apartment prices barely changed.

teaser.text: האינפלציה השנתית ירדה ל־1.5%, ובמחירי הדירות כמעט לא היה שינוי מחודש לחודש.

translations.ru: Годовая инфляция снизилась до 1,5%, а цены на квартиры почти не изменились от месяца к месяцу.
translations.en: Annual inflation fell to 1.5%, and apartment prices hardly changed from month to month.

translations.en: The July index rose by 0.3%, and apartments barely moved

teaser.text: האינפלציה השנתית ירדה ל־1.5%, ובין מה שהתייקר לבין מה שנשאר רגוע, משפחות צריכות להסתכל טוב על הקניות שלהן.

translations.ru: Годовая инфляция снизилась до 1,5%, и между тем, что подорожало, и тем, что осталось спокойным, семьям нужно внимательно смотреть на свои покупки.
translations.en: Annual inflation fell to 1.5%, and between what got more expensive and what stayed calm, families need to look closely at their shopping.

stories.brief: An Israel Antiquities Authority volume on ancient streets includes a study of a late Ottoman–early British Mandate roadside coffeehouse at Horses’ Beach in Acre. The subject is a very relatable historical scene: coffee, tobacco, trade, a roadside stop, and the way everyday commerce shaped movement along the coast.

sources.title: Atiqot Vol. 120, Ancient Streets, Pathways and Roads

stories.brief: An excavation report on Qedumim Square in Tel Yafo shows a long urban sequence, including an Umayyad fortress and an Ottoman street in the same area. The history is easy to tell with everyday vocabulary because it connects street lines, neighborhood growth, construction layers, and the changing use of a busy city site.

sources.title: The Northeastern Fringes of Yafo (Jaffa) in Light of the Excavations on Jerusalem Boulevard and Its Vicinity

stories.brief: An employee arrives at the office for an afternoon presentation and realizes the laptop charger is missing. They ask a coworker whether the spare charger in the meeting room fits, but it turns out to be the wrong one and the battery is already low. After a quick check in the drawer and one short message to reception, they borrow a compatible charger from another floor. The presentation starts a few minutes late, but the laptop stays on and the talk finishes without a bigger problem.

A resident notices that a delivery status says the package was left at the door, but nothing is outside their apartment. They message the courier company, explain the building entrance and floor number, and ask whether the package might have been left with a neighbor. The courier checks the photo, realizes the door number was hard to read, and calls back with the correct location. In the end, the resident finds the box in the lobby office and learns to add a clearer note next time.

On the way home after the gym, a parent stops at the supermarket for a few missing items and tries to stay within a small budget. They compare brands, notice that one item is already sold out, and ask an employee whether there is any stock in the back. The employee finds a smaller package that will do for tonight, so the parent changes the plan and skips the expensive extras. They leave with just enough food for dinner and a simple list for tomorrow.

AI-generated dialog. Two roommates, Dana and Amit, are in the kitchen after dinner. Dana notices the sink is draining very slowly and asks whether Amit already poured oil down it. Amit says no, but admits he washed a pan with a lot of sauce and probably made it worse. They discuss whether to try a plunger now or call the landlord in the morning, and Dana asks if they can at least clear the dishes first. They find a temporary fix, agree not to use the sink for the rest of the night, and send a message to the landlord. The practical outcome is that the clog does not get worse, and both know what to do next.

AI-generated dialog. Two friends, Maya and Noam, are trying to meet at the train station before going into the city. Maya says she is already at the station, but the platform has changed and the train is arriving from the other side. Noam asks which exit she is near and whether he should wait by the coffee stand or go down to the platform. Maya explains she is moving slowly because she is carrying a suitcase and the stairs are crowded. They confirm the train number, choose a clear meeting point, and decide to board together if it is still on time. The outcome is that they find each other without missing the train.

AI-generated dialog. Two neighbors, Ruth and Eyal, meet by the building entrance late in the evening. Ruth says she cannot find her key and may have left it in the car or at the pharmacy. Eyal asks whether she already checked her bag and the door mat, and then offers to call the other residents in the group chat in case someone found it. Ruth remembers she had dropped a small envelope earlier, so they look near the mailboxes and the elevator.
